problem.title: Every delayed case is a person who quietly decided it wasn't worth it.
problem.body: So the rational move on a routine dispute is to give up. That is not a backlog problem. It is an entire class of claims that never enters the justice system at all — and therefore never appears in any pendency statistic.

stats.label: Cases pending in India's district and taluka courts (civil and criminal)
Of those cases have been pending over 5 years — 9% for over a decade
Average wages or business income a litigant loses for each day at a lower-court hearing, separate from any lawyer's fee

problem.source: Sources: National Judicial Data Grid, district and taluka courts, civil and criminal, updated 21 July 2026; DAKSH Access to Justice Survey, 2015–16 (the lost-income figure is a decade old).

gate.body: Every case gets a confidence score based on how much of the record the system can actually stand on. Below threshold, it does not decide — it escalates to a human, by design and by default.
gate.prompt: Try it — how strong is each signal on your case?

signals.label: Intake completeness
signals.hint: How much of the filing is on the record

signals.label: Precedent coverage
signals.hint: How well past decisions cover this case

signals.label: Draft needed no correction
signals.hint: The validator did not have to rescue the draft

signals.label: Citations verified
signals.hint: Share of citations that survived checking

gate.passTitle: Above the floor — the checks continue
gate.passSub: A high score alone doesn't decide a case: jurisdiction, contested facts and the other safety checks still run first.
gate.failSub: Below the floor the system does not decide, so it hands the case to a person.

principles.title: Verbatim citation grounding
principles.body: Every precedent citation is checked against the source text. Any citation the model cannot ground is dropped, not surfaced.

principles.title: Deterministic fallbacks
principles.body: Scripted logic takes over when the model is unavailable — so an outage degrades quality, it does not fabricate an order.

principles.title: Append-only audit trail
principles.body: Every case writes to an append-only event log — every agent step, durably auditable after the fact.
